2608.23452.title: Reward-Free Continual Adaptation for Resilient Space Robots
2608.23452.paper_summary: Space robots operate in extreme environments where hardware degradation can critically compromise traditional control strategies. While continual reinforcement learning offers a promising mechanism for online adaptation, it inherently requires access to a reward signal during deployment. However, precise reward computation in space is often infeasible due to the lack of external tracking systems and the overall complexity of the environment. To address the challenge of unobservable rewards, we introduce a reward-free continual learning framework that leverages latent-state world models. By pre-training a model-based agent across diverse simulations, the world model learns a robust predictor of the reward structure within its latent space. Upon deployment to an environment with severe hardware degradation, we freeze the observation encoder and reward predictor to update only the transition dynamics of the world model through unsupervised rollouts. By training the policy entirely on imagined trajectories generated by this updated world model, the agent adapts to altered dynamics without receiving new rewards. We demonstrate our approach across simulated planetary traversal, orbital navigation, and precision assembly tasks subjected to severe morphological failures.
2608.23452.paper_summary_zh: 太空機器人在極端環境中運作，硬體退化可能會嚴重影響傳統控制策略。雖然持續強化學習提供了一種有前景的在線適應機制，但它本質上需要在部署期間獲取獎勵信號。然而，由於缺乏外部追蹤系統和環境的整體複雜性，在太空中精確計算獎勵通常是不可行的。為了解決不可觀察獎勵的挑戰，我們引入了一種無獎勵的持續學習框架，利用潛在狀態世界模型。通過在多樣的模擬中對基於模型的代理進行預訓練，世界模型學會了其潛在空間中獎勵結構的穩健預測器。在部署到一個硬體退化嚴重的環境中時，我們凍結觀察編碼器和獎勵預測器，只更新世界模型的轉換動力學，這是通過無監督的回放進行的。通過完全基於這個更新後的世界模型生成的想像軌跡來訓練策略，代理能夠在不接收新獎勵的情況下適應改變的動力學。我們在模擬的行星穿越、軌道導航和精密組裝任務中展示了我們的方法，這些任務遭受了嚴重的形態失效。
